contenders.handicapper_notes: Top pick. Proved his affinity for the Del Mar main track when finishing a clear and closing second with a sharp 92 speed rating over this exact one-mile distance on July 30. Gets the meet leading jockey Joel Rosario and fits this $16,000 claiming condition perfectly.

Significant class relief dropping out of the Real Good Deal Stakes and Los Alamitos Derby into claiming ranks. Won an open allowance route at Santa Anita earlier this year with an 84 figure and picks up Antonio Fresu.
Draws elite pilot Juan Hernandez and drops out of allowance company. Earned a huge 99 figure two back when missing by a nose over 6 furlongs at Del Mar and has the stamina to route effectively.

Possesses sharp early route speed and gets Kazushi Kimura for Tim Yakteen. Disregard last start where he stumbled at the break; his 91 figure gate-to-wire mile win three back makes him a major forward factor.
Consistent gelding for trainer Steven Miyadi. Boasts competitive dirt sprint figures (92 two back) and drew well inside to save ground into the first turn with Drayden Van Dyke.
Carries early speed and held on for third behind Mio Bambino at this track and trip on July 30. Wide draw is manageable on the dirt course.
